[SWS_CM_01383] A deserializer shall be aborted when a required argument has
an invalid wire type
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00204
⌈
If the deserializer finds a required (i.e. non-optional) member/argument defined in its
data definition in the serialized byte stream with invalid wire type, then the deserializa-
tion shall be aborted and the message shall be treated as malformed.
⌋
